import pandas as pd

# Read the source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_10/training_0.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Group by 'PRECINCT' and sum the relevant columns
agg_df = df.groupby('PRECINCT', as_index=False).agg({
    'ELIGIBLE_VOTERS': 'sum',
    'POLLS': 'sum',
    'EARLY_VOING': 'sum',
    'ABSENTEE': 'sum',
    'PROVISIONAL': 'sum'
})

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema
agg_df['PRECINCT'] = agg_df['PRECINCT'].astype(str)
agg_df['ELIGIBLE_VOTERS'] = agg_df['ELIGIBLE_VOTERS'].astype(int)
agg_df['POLLS'] = agg_df['POLLS'].astype(int)
agg_df['EARLY_VOING'] = agg_df['EARLY_VOING'].astype(int)
agg_df['ABSENTEE'] = agg_df['ABSENTEE'].astype(int)
agg_df['PROVISIONAL'] = agg_df['PROVISIONAL'].astype(int)

# Rename the DataFrame to the target table name
Target1_10 = agg_df

# Write the result to the specified path without the index column
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_10/target_multisource.csv"
Target1_10.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
